== Possibly faulty data ==
* Earlier Talk claimed no surviving HTML with EMBED SRC=puzzleN.dcr, and treated hangman JPEG pages as a post-week replacement. That is wrong. puzzle1.html is dated 03.10.97 (HTML comment dy) and is the contest page: a JPEG of card-art fragments plus daily letter fills. solution1.html at 19970327214330 (live-week on rothko) contains <code>&lt;embed src="puzzle1.dcr" width=368 height=520&gt;</code>. The Shockwave 4-by-6 slider of the full card, including the printed title, is the post-close solution, so the daily letter fills were not redundant. File:Decipher.com Dagobah Contest 1997 Shockwave puzzle N page.jpg shots wrap DCR stills in recovered chrome and are not original 1997 pages.
